---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new guide or an improvement to an existing one
title: ''
type: Feature
assignees: ''
---

**What kind of request is this?**

- [ ] A **new** guide
- [ ] A **feature or improvement** for an existing guide

**Which guide?**
For an existing one, name the guide folder (e.g. `python/langgraph/plan-and-execute-data-agent`,
`typescript/openai/codex-sdk`). For a new one, name the framework, tool, or use case you'd like
a guide for (e.g. a new agent framework, an RL trainer, a model-serving stack).

**What problem does it solve?**
A clear and concise description of the problem or use case. Ex. "When using Daytona with
[...], I can't [...]"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should the guide demonstrate? Include the key capabilities, tools, or workflow it should
cover.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions, existing workarounds, or other tools you've considered.

**Additional context**
Links to the relevant framework/tool docs/API, screenshots, or any other context.
